_about: The ERIX voice library: every voice a customer can pick, by its ERIX code. Provider speaker names live only in scripts/voice-ids.json. Every voice says the same line; the Hindi line avoids gendered verbs. Rendered by scripts/voice-samples.py --set library.

lines.en: Hello, thank you for calling. Whether you want to book an appointment or ask a question, just tell me. How can I help you today?
lines.hi: नमस्ते, call करने के लिए धन्यवाद। Appointment book करनी हो या कोई सवाल पूछना हो, बताइए। आज आपकी क्या मदद करूँ?
lines.te: నమస్కారం, call చేసినందుకు ధన్యవాదాలు. Appointment book చేయాలన్నా, ఏదైనా అడగాలన్నా చెప్పండి. ఈరోజు మీకు ఎలా సహాయం చేయగలను?
